bound_formula: T=1+w+N+2+E; E counts 0x7d/0x7e in length/body/CRC bytes; T<=1+2*(w+N+2); w in {1,2,4}
reply_note: Some branches add an extra one-byte field; maximum remains opcode+status+128=130. List counts 11 or15 give33/45. 26130 emits status+9. 2607c emits one status on returning.
excluded: Not all possible indirect calls, corrupt state, log argument contents, reentrant schedules, real CRC/timing.
